summary: Name-guarded vehicle dispatch. Defaults the result to 0; when the name argument a1 is non-null it performs a vehicle lookup by name via VehicleLookupByName (return value discarded) and then returns the current vehicle accessor. On null input returns the default 0.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 as the default return value before the guard.
Guard on a1: the lookup/accessor path only runs when the name argument a1 is non-null.
VehicleLookupByName(a1): resolve the vehicle referenced by a1; the returned value is discarded.

CurrentVehicleAccessor(): return the current vehicle accessor result as the function value. Callers span vehicle-config lookup/insertion (LookUpVehicleConfigEntry, AddVehicleConfigEntryToLinkedList), netcomm session dispatch, particle spawn, season scene lookup and three unnamed paths.
Null path: when a1 is null, return the default result (0).

unresolved: The return value of VehicleLookupByName is discarded; the side effect of selecting the current vehicle is inferred from the accessor call that follows.
The type of the a1 name argument (string pointer vs id) is not specified in the raw source.
The LEGACY ABI lead provides no owner identity or additional semantic signal.
